placement: Guardrail — tools/contract-gen/model.ts gains one well-formedness rule: in a union, a variant's field may not be named like a different variant of the same union (C# nests each variant as a record inside the union class, and the inherited nested type shadows the positional property; limen.media failed only in the C# build). A field named like its own variant stays allowed, as core's Event { event } shows. Tested in test/contract.test.ts. Stricter, never weaker: every existing contract already satisfies it.
